knowledge_gaps: The experiment is reasonable, but reproducibility still requires a concrete epoch count, remaining GPU budget, measured runtime estimates for all twelve category-condition fits, and an explicit learning-rate schedule. Research progress is not a budget measurement.

The actual baseline loss is unspecified. Masking must preserve its negative-candidate construction, reduction, regularization and any cross-position coupling; identical suffix masks alone do not establish matched supervision.

Separate sampler and crop RNGs do not guarantee matched batches if sampling shares randomness with dropout or diagnostics. Record or deterministically regenerate batch, negative and crop plans, and verify identical initialization across conditions.

C−B measures the complete training-context intervention, including changes in gradient paths and recurrent execution. It does not isolate harmful older interests or establish current user intent. Full-history inference also introduces a training–inference context difference that should be measured.

No validation results or uncertainty estimates support the potential rating of 8. The ratings are subjective; originality needs comparison with supervised sequence-cropping methods beyond TimeSHAP, and implementation difficulty depends on the baseline loss and host trial interface.

Selection across three conditions adds validation-selection bias. Report category scores and paired uncertainty when host per-user hits are available; seed-42 results cannot establish training-seed robustness.
